About this Event

Get ready to stretch, smile, and potentially meet your new best friend!
Join us for a beginner-friendly, all-levels yoga flow surrounded by adorable, adoptable small dogs from Small Chance Rescue. Their mission is to give small breed dogs a chance at loving forever homes, and a portion of ticket proceeds from this event will go directly toward supporting their rescue efforts.

Bring your yoga mat, a water bottle, and get ready to flow with the dogs as they roam, play, and meet you throughout the class. The yoga class will be taught by Taylor Cook and is designed to be welcoming for all levels.
Event Schedule
2:00 to 2:30 PM: Meet the dogs, mingle, and learn more about Small Chance Rescue2:30 to 3:30 PM: All-levels yoga class with adoptable dogs3:30 to 4:00 PM: Meet the dogs, learn about adoption and fostering, and connect with the rescue
Whether you're looking to adopt, interested in fostering, or simply want to enjoy a fun yoga class surrounded by tiny four-legged friends, this is a chance to support local rescue while potentially meeting your new best friend!
